* `Becoming.Coupling` (L4): where a move is formed, with no premise beyond what each law names. In a
  part and the rest coupled by one move formed within the whole, the move is the part's exactly
  where it is a policy of the part, the rest's exactly where it is a policy of the rest, and both
  only where it is the same everywhere; an own move closes the part and is the rest's input. Every
  run of a labelled process, whatever its moves, is the part's course in a whole whose rest, a
  clock, forms them; moves formed within a whole held by a list repeat, and every lasso is so
  formed. The record of one course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with
  the move varied; where nothing recurs, as with a kept history, every reading fits.
readme_row: | L4 | [`Becoming.Coupling`](Becoming/Coupling.lean) | 动作在哪里形成（除了各律所写者不加前提）：部分与其余由在整体之内形成的一个动作耦合（`coupled`），动作是部分的，恰当它是部分的策略（`partForms_iff`），是其余的，恰当它是其余的策略（`restForms_iff`），两者都是恰在它处处相同时（`partForms_and_restForms_iff`），由两者之关系形成的动作不由任一方单独形成（`Parity.neither_alone`）；部分自己的动作封闭部分（`PartForms.goAlike`、`PartForms.parts_agree`），又是其余的输入（`Run.rest_driven_by_part`）；每个带标签过程的每个运行，无论动作如何，都是一个整体中部分的进程，其余是一只钟，由它形成动作（`Run.withClock`）；被列表所持的整体之内形成的动作重复（`Run.moves_lasso_of_whole_held`），每个套索都如此形成（`Run.withLasso`）；一段进程的记录只在某个配置复现而动作不同之处固定动作是谁的（`lumped_iff_singleValued`、`no_policy_upto_iff`），无物复现时每种读法都合（`lumped_of_new`、`Run.keepHistory_formed`、`TwoClocks.one_course_two_laws`） / where a move is formed (no premise beyond what each law names): in a part and the rest coupled by one move formed within the whole (`coupled`), the move is the part's exactly where it is a policy of the part (`partForms_iff`), the rest's exactly where it is a policy of the rest (`restForms_iff`), and both only where it is the same everywhere (`partForms_and_restForms_iff`); a move formed by their relation is formed by neither alone (`Parity.neither_alone`); an own move closes the part (`PartForms.goAlike`, `PartForms.parts_agree`) and is the rest's input (`Run.rest_driven_by_part`); every run of a labelled process, whatever its moves, is the part's course in a whole whose rest, a clock, forms them (`Run.withClock`); moves formed within a whole held by a list repeat (`Run.moves_lasso_of_whole_held`), and every lasso is so formed (`Run.withLasso`); the record of one course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with the move varied (`lumped_iff_singleValued`, `no_policy_upto_iff`), and where nothing recurs every reading fits (`lumped_of_new`, `Run.keepHistory_formed`, `TwoClocks.one_course_two_laws`) |
chapter_row: | L4 | [Becoming.Coupling](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Coupling.lean) | 动作在哪里形成（除了各律所写者不加前提）：部分与其余由在整体之内形成的一个动作耦合，动作是部分的恰当它是部分的策略，是其余的恰当它是其余的策略，两者都是恰在它处处相同时，由两者之关系形成者不由任一方单独形成；自己的动作封闭部分，又是其余的输入；每个带标签过程的运行都是一个整体中部分的进程，其余是形成动作的钟；被列表所持者形成的动作重复，每个套索都如此形成；一段进程的记录只在某个配置复现而动作不同之处固定动作是谁的，无物复现时每种读法都合。/ Where a move is formed, with no premise beyond what each law names: in a part and the rest coupled by one move formed within the whole, the move is the part's exactly where it is a policy of the part, the rest's exactly where it is a policy of the rest, and both only where it is the same everywhere, a move formed by their relation being formed by neither alone; an own move closes the part and is the rest's input; every run of a labelled process is the part's course in a whole whose rest is a clock forming its moves; what a list holds forms moves that repeat, and every lasso is so formed; the record of one course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with the move varied, and where nothing recurs every reading fits. | 51 |
